apiDocs.title: API Integration
apiDocs.overviewHint: Integrate with this instance over HTTP + SSE. Samples use the current Origin as Base URL.
apiDocs.flow1: Sign in or exchange an API key for a JWT
apiDocs.flow3: Render text / tools / completion by event type
apiDocs.flow4: Resume with done.session_id, or handle approvals
apiDocs.authHint: With state.db attached, all /v1 business APIs require credentials. Prefer JWT.
apiDocs.authHeaderBearer: Authorization: Bearer <JWT or raw API key>
apiDocs.authKeysHint: You can also create API keys under Settings → Security; the response includes a JWT and the raw key is never shown again.
apiDocs.fieldApiKey: Raw API key registered on the server
apiDocs.runHint: Primary integration endpoint. Response is text/event-stream; each event is data: {JSON}\n\n.
apiDocs.runEndpointTitle: Run an agent and stream events
apiDocs.runResponseHint: Content-Type: text/event-stream. Read as a stream; do not parse the whole body as JSON.
apiDocs.fieldSessionId: Optional; pass previous done.session_id to resume
apiDocs.fieldModel: Optional; overrides the agent default model. Locked after the session's first run
apiDocs.fieldRunProvider: Optional provider for model; resolved from enabled lists if omitted
apiDocs.eventsHint: Branch on type; end the turn on done or error.
apiDocs.approveHint: When you receive tool_approval_required, approve or deny with approval_id.
apiDocs.approveEndpointTitle: Approve or deny a pending tool
apiDocs.fieldApproved: true to approve, false to deny
apiDocs.sessionHint: Sessions are scoped per user. List agents to obtain ids for run.agent.
apiDocs.sessionList: List sessions for the current user
apiDocs.errorsHint: Non-stream errors are JSON; in-stream failures arrive as type=error events.
apiDocs.errLang: Set Accept-Language: zh-CN | en to localize message

settings.title: Settings
settings.backgroundHint: Upload an image or video (mp4/webm, played as an animated wallpaper) as the workspace background with adjustable opacity and blur. Auto-adapt switches light/dark mode by the media's luminance.
settings.backgroundAdaptHint: Switch light/dark by the image's average luminance (theme palette stays unchanged)
settings.accountHint: Register or sign in. Each user has isolated sessions and API keys. After the first password account exists, /v1/ requires a JWT.
settings.apiKeyHint: Leave empty to keep the existing API key
settings.apiKeyDeleteConfirm: Delete key "{{name}}"? Clients using it will lose access immediately.
settings.apiKeyCreatedHint: The raw key is shown only this once. Copy it now and store it somewhere safe.
settings.userDeleteConfirm: Delete user "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
settings.registrationHint: Allow anyone who can reach the login page to create an account. When off, only admins can add users.
settings.embeddingHint: Configured independently from chat providers. Only embedding-capable vendors (Qwen / Ollama) are listed — not DeepSeek or Kimi.
settings.embeddingApiKeyKeep: Leave blank to keep existing key
settings.embeddingDimensionsHint: Supported by text-embedding-v3/v4 etc. Re-ingest after changing. Default 1024.
settings.mcpPerAgentHint: These servers are defined in their agent's YAML — edit them on the agent editor page.
settings.workDirHint: Root directory for file tools. Browse the remote server path, or leave empty for the server start directory. Sessions can override this individually from the chat page.
settings.subagentHint: Turns, concurrency, and timeout are process-wide, not per Agent YAML. Nesting depth is fixed at 1: only the main agent can spawn. Sub-agents use their own concurrency queue and do not consume tool parallel slots.
settings.subagentMaxTurnsHint: Turn cap for each nested run (default 5).
settings.subagentMaxConcurrentHint: How many child runs may execute at once; extras wait in queue (default 2).
settings.subagentTimeoutHint: 0 means no extra timeout beyond the parent run.
settings.shellHint: Linux/Unix defaults to Bash, macOS to zsh, otherwise sh. Windows prefers Git Bash when installed.
settings.shellUnixHint: Only one terminal was detected; no choice is needed.
settings.browseDirDesc: Browse the remote server filesystem and pick a directory.
settings.mcpHint: Add MCP servers via the mcp_servers field in Agent YAML.
settings.providersEmpty: No providers yet. Add one below.
settings.providerEnabledModelsHint: Select the models users can pick in chat. Unchecked models stay hidden.
settings.providerVisionHint: Checked automatically when the model list or detail reports multimodal; otherwise off.
settings.modelDetailEmpty: Detail will be queried after selecting a model
settings.modelDetailUnsupported: This provider does not support model detail
settings.providerVendorPlaceholder: Pick a built-in vendor to autofill
settings.providerModelsPathHint: Override for Ollama or OpenAI-compatible servers with a non-standard list path.
settings.fetchModelsHint: Fetch model list from vendor (requires a saved API key)
settings.fetchModelsLocalHint: Fetch installed models from local Ollama
settings.fetchModelsNoKey: Fill in the API key first, then fetch models
settings.fetchModelsViaOpenAI: Anthropic endpoints of this vendor don't expose a model list; fetching via the OpenAI-compatible endpoint automatically.
settings.apiKeyOptionalHint: Local Ollama needs no API key; leave it empty.
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete Provider {{name}}? This cannot be undone.
settings.apiKeyEnvHint: Leave empty to keep the existing environment variable name

agent.sectionIdentityDesc: Define the agent name, provider, and model.
agent.sectionToolsDesc: Select tools and set a permission policy for each.
agent.sectionRuntimeDesc: Control turn limits, token budget, and tool execution.
agent.sectionKnowledgeDesc: Selecting bases auto-enables knowledge_search / knowledge_list and scopes retrieval.
agent.sectionOptimizeDesc: Optimize prompts with an LLM before runs; falls back to the original on failure.
agent.optimizeSystemPromptHint: Restructures the system prompt into a tagged XML form using the selected model; review the result and save to apply
agent.optimizeUserPromptHint: Optimizes each user prompt before the run; adds one LLM call per turn
agent.knowledgeEmpty: No knowledge bases yet — create one under Manage → Knowledge
agent.sectionMcpDesc: Connect external MCP servers to this agent; their tools are discovered and registered at runtime.
agent.mcpEmpty: No MCP servers configured — click Add in the top right.
agent.mcpNameHint: Unique server id, shown in logs and status.
agent.mcpCommandHint: Required for stdio; path to the executable.
agent.mcpUrlHint: Required for SSE; remote MCP endpoint.
agent.nameHint: Display name — can be changed anytime after creation.
agent.idHint: Stable identifier used by API and sessions. Cannot be changed.
agent.systemPromptDesc: System prompt that defines the agent role and behavior.
agent.maxTurnsHint: 0 = unlimited until the model stops calling tools. Positive values are a safety cap. Long runs rely on context compaction.
agent.maxTokensHint: Maximum output tokens for a single model reply (output cap, not the context window). "Auto" uses the model's official spec.
agent.contextWindowHint: Model context window size, used to trigger compaction. Leave unset to use the runtime/provider default.
agent.compactionStrategyHint: History is compacted automatically as the context window fills. No setting required.
agent.execModeHint: Parallel runs tools concurrently; serial runs them in order.
agent.maxParallelHint: Max concurrent tools when execution mode is parallel.
